description: This Java class defines the AttributeDeletedStrategy, which handles AttributeDeleted events within the Eclipse Ditto framework by removing attributes from a ThingBuilder.

classes.name: AttributeDeletedStrategy
classes.description: Handles AttributeDeleted events by removing the specified attribute from a ThingBuilder object.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies an AttributeDeleted event to a ThingBuilder by removing the attribute specified in the event.
